g.text: *Verify USB 5V is available on your board pin and its current path is adequate. Never feed MQ135 AOUT directly to a GPIO.
Logical wiring schematic, not PCB layout. Check actual module labels. R1/R2: 1%, 1/4W. C1: near GPIO34. Power off before rewiring.
